description: He wears a knee-length dark moss-green wool tunic with gold knotwork trim at the front opening, cuffs and hem, over a cream linen underlayer visible at the collar and wrists. A large dark green, brown and ochre checked woven cloak drapes across both shoulders and down one side, held by a round metal knotwork brooch. A broad brown leather belt with a decorated circular buckle and hanging strap secures the waist. Brown wool trousers and soft brown leather boots with crossed wrapping straps complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons are present.
